description:
Reviews, one at a time.

Add the Letterboxd members whose writing you love, then swipe up through their film reviews as full-screen reels: one per page, nothing else on screen.

A FEED WITH AN END
Each session holds 20 reviews (or 10, 30 or 50, your choice), then stops on a "Fin" card. Keep reading if you want to, but on purpose. Come back later and a new session is waiting.

THE WORDS FIRST
• Only written reviews. No lists, no likes, no comments.
• Set like a magazine page: poster, title, year, rating, then the text with its italics, quotes and links.
• Hide the stars and likes to read the words before the verdict.
• Reviews with spoilers stay covered until you tap.
• Long reviews open in a full reader.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
VILLE comes in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese and Chinese. When a review is written in another language, one tap translates it, right on your iPhone. Long-press the text to copy a passage.

PICKED WITH CARE
New reviews come first, newest first, then the ones you read longest ago. Members take turns, so no one fills your feed, and VILLE avoids showing the same member or film twice in a row. Pull the first reel down to check for new reviews.

THE FILM AROUND THE WORDS
A different backdrop each time a film appears, and its poster, or alternative posters from other countries' releases. Tap a poster to flip it. Tap a title to look the film up. Prefer pure text? Turn the art off. Light, dark or system appearance.

START IN GOOD COMPANY
Not sure whom to follow? VILLE suggests critics, writers, filmmakers and creators who review often.

YOURS, ON YOUR IPHONE
No account. No ads. No tracking. Everything you add stays on your iPhone, and the reviews you've read stay saved even after they leave a member's feed.

CREDIT WHERE IT'S DUE
Every review shows its author and links back to the original on Letterboxd. Sharing sends that link, never the text.

VILLE reads the public RSS feeds of the Letterboxd members you add. Reviews belong to their authors. VILLE is not affiliated with or endorsed by Letterboxd. Film images come from TMDB: this product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
promotionalText: Add the people whose film writing you love on Letterboxd and read their reviews as full-screen reels. One at a time, and with an end.
